note: The gate on draft 2. One major (19:7a, on words he had marked minor on draft 1) and one minor (19:7b, on the stylist's line).

outcomes.remark: MAJOR: 'agora sei' keeps only the resulting state; the perfect says the coming-to-know → 'agora soube'
outcomes.reason: His fix was already an option: the perfect of 'come to know' in saber, the verb Portuguese uses with 'que' (118:152). 'agora sei' stays one touch away. (minor → major on the same words: D24's variance.)

outcomes.remark: minor: 'atos de poder' makes the acts explicit → back to 'em poderes'
outcomes.reason: 'em poderes' was the stylist's worst line (no footing in current Portuguese); 'atos de poder' keeps the root and the plural, as the Greek δυναστεῖαι. 'em poderes' remains option 2.
